name: captains-cabinet-marketplace
description: Distribution channel for the Captains Cabinet plugin, its preset variants, and optional capability packs. Authoritative source for plugin install paths.
_source_note: Convention: every plugins[].source below points at the SAME repo+ref — the repository this marketplace file lives in. When forking or retargeting a deployment, update source.repo and source.ref in ALL entries together (see cabinet/docs/cabinet-plugin-installation.md, 'Capability packs'). Claude Code ignores this field at load time.

plugins.name: captains-cabinet
plugins.description: Full Captains Cabinet plugin: framework + presets (work, portfolio, personal) + 21 skills + 6 slash commands + 6 MCP servers. The officer fleet is roster-derived (instance/config/roster.yml) — the work preset ships 8 role archetypes, the portfolio preset ships the Chair plus generated lane CEOs.

plugins.name: captains-cabinet-personal
plugins.description: Personal Cabinet variant — coaching-focused, lighter governance, Captain triplet only. Selects the personal preset via instance/config/active-preset at first run.

plugins.name: doctrine-pack
plugins.description: Optional doctrine skills: holistic-thinking, production-quality-ownership, individual-reflection, cross-officer-retro, spec-quality-gate. Parallel copies of the core plugin's skills — the core still ships the originals this wave.

plugins.name: vercel-lane-pack
plugins.description: Vercel-lane deployment skills: deploy-and-verify (push, poll Vercel, validate live, then announce) and engineering-development-loop. Skip if your lanes do not deploy on Vercel.

plugins.name: agent-teams-pack
plugins.description: Agent Teams workflow skill for current CLI reality (>= v2.1.178, TeamCreate removed): implicit teams, teammates via the Agent tool's name param, worker+reviewer patterns, worktree isolation, model routing, headless boundary. Requires CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1.

plugins.name: preset-portfolio-pack
plugins.description: Portfolio preset orientation + activation guide (one persistent Chair + per-lane CEO officers). References the presets/portfolio payload shipped with the core plugin — install captains-cabinet first.

plugins.name: preset-personal-pack
plugins.description: Personal preset orientation + activation guide (coaching-focused, consent-gated autonomy). References the presets/personal payload shipped with the core plugin — install captains-cabinet first.

plugins.name: lighthouse-log-pack
plugins.description: Daily keeper's log skill: compose a short, honest digest of the day's org events from the world chronicle into a Tier 2 note (honest zeros, demo rows labeled, no network). Authored-in-pack original — also the pack-authoring exemplar that docs/authoring-a-pack.md builds step by step.
